title: Cycle Count System Values

children:
These values are miscellaneous technical values that the system uses 
 when processing cycle counts. You will need to address some of these values, 
 depending whether or not if you are using cycle count plans. Ask your 
 system consultant before changing any of these values.
Note: Use with plan based and non-plan based (activity-driven) cycle counting

Use the following table to see what values you will need to address 
 for the two methods of cycle counting:
Work Unit Field For Activity Driven Work
Create Activity Driven and Quick Plan Cycle Count Work

Auto Print Cycle Count List: 
 The system uses this value to determine if you want the system to print 
 a cycle count list, after a plan has been run using a scheduled job.

Auto Release Cycle Count Plan: 
 The system uses this value to determine if you want the system to automatically 
 release a plan, after a plan has been run using a scheduled job.

Activity Count - Negative Adjustment: 
 The value you identify here is used by the system when writing transaction 
 history records, whenever you perform a negative adjustment on an activity 
 (non-plan-based) driven cycle count request. Note that this action can 
 also be interfaced back to the ERP, if defined to do so on the Adjustment 
 Type Window.

Activity Count - Positive Adjustment: 
 The value you identify here is used by the system when writing transaction 
 history records, whenever you perform a positive adjustment on an activity 
 (non-plan-based) driven cycle count request. Note that this action can 
 also be interfaced back to the ERP, if defined to do so on the Adjustment 
 Type Window.

Planned Count - Negative Adjustment: 
 The value you identify here is used by the system when writing transaction 
 history records, whenever you perform a negative adjustment on a plan-based 
 driven cycle count request. Note that this action can also be interfaced 
 back to the ERP, if defined to do so on the Adjustment Type Window.
** Note that the system will use the value specified on the cycle count quick plan and will only use this value if nothing is selected.

Planned Count - Positive Adjustment: 
 The value you identify here is used by the system when writing transaction 
 history records, whenever you perform a positive adjustment on a plan-based 
 driven cycle count request. Note that this action can also be interfaced 
 back to the ERP, if defined to do so on the Adjustment Type Window.
** Note that the system will use the value specified on the cycle count quick plan and will only use this value if nothing is selected.

Work Unit Field For Activity Driven 
 Work: This value is used to set the work unit on activity [non-plan] 
 driven requests (if you are creating work for these requests).

Create Activity Driven and Quick Plan Cycle Count Work: The system uses this value to indicate if it should create work instructions for both activity-driven [non-plan] requests and requests generated from cycle count "quick plans." Note that if this value is set to Y, then the Create Work Check box on the Cycle Count Quick Plan Window will default as selected (the user can always turn this option off from that window if desired).

Default Cycle Count Group Size: 
 This value allows you to group your cycle counts, which provides easier 
 ways of managing them. You can use these groups in the quick find window 
 and when printing to limit the amount of cycle counts the system displays 
 or prints. This default group size is used when creating a plan and when 
 printing. The user, however, does have the ability to override the default. This value is also defaulted on the Counts Per Group Field on the Cycle Count Quick Plan Window.

SRC Identifier for Activity Driven Work- System will use this value during work creation and record it on the work unit details. The defined SRC identifier will be used to create work for activity driven cycle count.
